purpose: Pre-outcome candidate proposals; no superiority claim
selectionBasis: Readability, real domain coherence, unambiguous defect witnesses, clean controls and repair-preservation obligations before live results.

candidates.domain: A report is downloaded by its requester or emailed to recipients. Download has no recipient list; email has at least one recipient.
clean: delivery: { mode: "download"; recipients?: never } | { mode: "email"; recipients: readonly [string, ...string[]] };
candidates.repair: Replace independent delivery fields with a tagged delivery value, or a top-level tagged union preserving the other fields.
candidates.probePolicy: Build complete objects from a common neutral baseline, overriding only relevant facts. Probe assignments through variables too, to avoid excess-property-only credit. Require all ancillary fields and the displayLabel rename to remain.
candidates.scope: single-file declaration; tests visibility beyond edited hunk rather than imported definitions
candidates.caution: Size tiers intentionally preserve relevant domain semantics and names; added fields have domain meaning. Labels alone never instruct the agent to repair a finding. Adjacent and separated have identical field sets.

assignmentProbes.note: Expressions use the defective public representation. Oracle must adapt access paths for alternative repaired representations; deleting facts is not a repair. Baseline provides all unaffected fields. For branded identities declare workspaceIdentity: WorkspaceIdentity and accountIdentity: AccountIdentity.

candidates.domain: A webhook attempt either does not retry or uses exponential backoff. Backoff settings have meaning only for the retry policy.

candidates.repair: Use a tagged retry policy; keep never and both supported backoff choices.

candidates.domain: Membership associates a workspace with an account. Workspace and account identities name different domain objects and cannot substitute for each other. This is the in-memory domain command, not a wire payload.
valid: workspace identity in workspace and account identity in account
candidates.repair: Distinct nominal/branded identity types with constructors or existing domain objects. Prefix checks alone do not prevent substitution.

support.support.ts:
export type WorkspaceIdentity = string & { readonly __workspace: unique symbol };
export type AccountIdentity = string & { readonly __account: unique symbol };

limitations: Large-separated moves label relative to the issue and may separate related fields; distinguish hunk visibility from relation distance.
Small variants have fewer ancillary fields but identical relevant facts; adjacent versus separated is the strict layout-only contrast.
Cross-file definitions form a separate condition rather than being conflated with declaration size.
